title: attest: Fail-Closed Machine Learning with Model Certificates
description: An R package that fits predictive models carrying an immutable certificate of validity. Leakage, calibration, conformal coverage and distribution-shift checks run at fit time and are stored inside the model object, bound to the training data by hash. Predictions are returned with an interval and a validity status, and are refused by default when inputs fall outside the certified support. Reports (model cards) are rendered from the certificate so they cannot drift from the model.
